cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.

mechanism: A supervises packing with growing alarm about polish and footprints while calmly accepting a floating table.
confusable: Practical acceptance alone misses D165's disproportionate alarm at ordinary details.
comparison: Preservation during a move differs from guest etiquette at tea.
seedUse: Keep cup, ladder and boots, but explicitly establish whether B intends stepping on the table before warning about footprints.
